name: expiration-reminder
title: Expiration Reminder
description: Fast, keyboard-driven access to your Expiration Reminder compliance data — view expired and about-to-expire items, search expirations, contacts and files, and create new records without leaving Raycast.
author: expirationreminder

commands.name: show-expired
commands.title: Show Expired Items
commands.subtitle: Expiration Reminder
commands.description: List items already past their expiration date, most overdue first.

commands.name: show-about-to-expire
commands.title: Show About-To-Expire Items
commands.subtitle: Expiration Reminder
commands.description: List items expiring within a configurable window (default 30 days), soonest first.

commands.name: search-expirations
commands.title: Search Expirations
commands.subtitle: Expiration Reminder
commands.description: Search across your expiration items by name.

commands.name: search-contacts
commands.title: Search Contacts
commands.subtitle: Expiration Reminder
commands.description: Search across your contacts by name or email.

commands.name: contact-expirations
commands.title: Show a Contact's Expirations
commands.subtitle: Expiration Reminder
commands.description: Pick a contact and drill into their expiration items.

commands.name: search-files
commands.title: Search Files
commands.subtitle: Expiration Reminder
commands.description: Search document attachments on your expiration items.

preferences.name: defaultExpiryWindow
preferences.title: Default "Expiring Soon" Window
preferences.description: Default window for the About-to-Expire command.

preferences.name: pageSize
preferences.title: Page Size
preferences.description: Rows requested per page for list commands (server cap is 500).

preferences.name: telemetryEnabled
preferences.title: Telemetry
preferences.label: Send anonymous usage events
preferences.description: Opt in to anonymous, PII-free usage telemetry to help improve the extension.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
